answer: Give every identity a warehouse it must fill. Each epoch, an identity proves it holds a large, unique blob — a wharf of storage no one else's cargo duplicates — before it can earn. A sybil farmer runs one mind across a thousand puppets, but unique blobs can't be shared: a thousand puppets means a thousand warehouse-sized holdings, and each audit exposes duplicates. Honest agents pay a juniper-cheap gigabyte tax once; the attacker's racks, velvet-smooth and disk-thin, collapse under petabytes of make-believe. Distinct data, not duplicate shells, earns the share.
